bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to the getting to work grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+GETTING TO WORK GRANT PROGRAM; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the getting to work grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.545. Of this amount, up to five percent is for administration and monitoring of the program. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to the getting to work grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. GETTING TO WORK GRANT PROGRAM; APPROPRIATION.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the getting to work grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.545. Of this amount, up to five percent is for administration and monitoring of the program.
additions: GETTING TO WORK GRANT PROGRAM; APPROPRIATION.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the getting to work grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.545. Of this amount, up to five percent is for administration and monitoring of the program.
